profiles.title: AI budget and a clone
profiles.question: Do you bring an AI budget (or your own reading and typing) and nothing else: no Unity Editor, no headset, no repository rights?
profiles.brings: A clone of the default branch, Python 3.11 or later, the pinned contract dependencies, and an AI budget or the time to do the same work by hand.
may_never_claim: that any C# compiled or any test executed, because no Editor ran; every such change stays authored and unexecuted under Unreleased
a package version bump, a maturity change, a compatibility profile, a release, or a tag
any XR runtime, controller, comfort, spatial-audio, or headset behaviour

profiles.title: A machine with the pinned Unity Editor
profiles.question: Do you bring a machine that can open the Unity Editor version the compatibility profiles pin, in addition to a clone?
profiles.brings: Everything the AI-budget profile brings, plus an Editor that can run the package EditMode and PlayMode tests and write a gate receipt.
may_never_claim: any XR runtime, controller, comfort, spatial-audio, or headset behaviour, which needs a Device Lab receipt from a named device
a maturity promotion or a release, which stay a recorded maintainer decision
that an Editor result transfers to another Unity, renderer, provider, or device tuple than the one the receipt names

profiles.title: A named headset you can install a build on
profiles.question: Do you bring a headset the Device Lab names, and the ability to install a build on it and record what you observe?
profiles.brings: A named device, a way to install a build of an exact commit (your own Editor build or a published artifact), and the patience to fill every field of a device receipt.
may_never_claim: behaviour on any device, build target, renderer, or input route other than the exact tuple the receipt records
a maturity promotion or a release, which stay a recorded maintainer decision
an observation without the commit, artifact digest, dependency lock, environment, input sources, posture, and duration the receipt schema requires; not_tested is never evidence

profiles.title: Repository rights on this repository
profiles.question: Do you hold rights on this repository: settings, secrets, branch protection, tags, releases, and the signature on an admission or maturity decision?
profiles.brings: The acts no contributor and no Agent can perform: repository settings and secrets, required checks and auto-merge, tags and releases, admission and maturity signatures, and closing a governance record a person must resolve.
may_never_claim: an Editor or device result without its receipt; rights are not evidence
that a signature replaces the gate it signs, or that a merge against a blocked verdict needs no recorded reason
